sentences: 2 similar listed companies trade at 39.1x to 47.1x their yearly profit (middle: 43.1x), at today's market prices.
Applied to its earnings per share of ₹1.48 in Q1FY27 (₹5.92 for a full year), a share would be worth ₹231.33 (low), ₹255.20 (middle) or ₹279.06 (high).
Against the top of the price band, ₹344, the middle value means 25.8% downside.
Q1FY27 covers only part of a year; scaling it up assumes the rest of the year goes the same way.
Cross-check: at the peers' middle EV/EBITDA of 28.7x, after taking off net debt, a share would be worth ₹523.91 against ₹255.20 from P/E: the two differ by more than 20%, so treat both with care.
This is a rough guide, not a forecast: it assumes the company deserves the same price tag as its listed peers.
